volume: LROLRC_2001 (LRO-L-LROC-5-RDR-V1.0), BDR WAC_POLE, product version v1.3 (created 2020-08-31)

browse_geotiff_crosscheck.result: equals the PDS3-header geotransform; 8-bit values correlate 0.99999 with the float map read at byte 9712

documented_facts.fact: one lunar year of WAC images, 15 February 2010 to 5 February 2011, 3807 observations plus 229 gap fills at virtually identical lighting
each image map-projected at 100 m/pixel onto a 30 m LOLA DEM; binary lit images from 'a series of spatial filters and a conservative global threshold'; value = times illuminated / times imaged
TWI weights images from infrequent periods twice and linearly interpolates areas outside the field of view; PCT does not account for non-linear temporal sampling
image noise and scattered light leave values close to, but not equal to, zero inside permanently shadowed regions; ignore them
88-90 deg S, polar stereographic, 1737.4 km sphere, 100 m/pixel, 1214 x 1214, PC_REAL 32-bit, CORE_NULL 16#FF7FFFFB#
WAC 643 nm imaging; repeat coverage every orbit for 88-90 deg

label_defects: PDS4 label Array offset = 4856 bytes, but the attached PDS3 header is 2 records x 4856 bytes and ^IMAGE = 3: the image starts at byte 9712. Reading at 4856 returns header text and values up to ~1e19.
PDS4 label Cartography upperleft_corner_x/y = +60650; the grid's upper-left pixel centre is (-60650, +60650) and its corner (-60700, +60700) (PDS3 header and LROC's GeoTIFF).

psr_interior_twi_pct.source: PGDA 90 LPSR interior cells (2-cell margin) inside 88-90 S

measured.coregistration_with_pgda90: LROC==0 vs LPSR fully-shadowed 100 m pixels: best IoU 0.863 at zero shift (0.858-0.860 at +-1 pixel)
